title: The final challenge
excerpts: Build a complete privacy-preserving voting system integrating all concepts.
This is the boss battle - integration of everything from witness to Merkle trees.
Only by combining all pieces can you succeed.

title: The scenario: private election
excerpts: Eligible voters must prove membership without revealing identity.

title: Why this matters
excerpts: This integration demonstrates real-world privacy-preserving applications.
Mastering all these concepts enables building systems that protect privacy.
This is the future of voting, airdrops, and more.

title: Step 1: Identity and eligibility
excerpts: Use witness for private identity data.
Use Merkle tree for eligibility list.
Circuit proves voter is in the list without revealing identity.

codeBlocks.title: Documented Merkle membership pattern

title: Step 2: Vote encryption and commitment
excerpts: Use persistentCommit with a private opening to create a persistent vote commitment.
A commitment hides the vote and binds the sender to an opening; it is not an encryption API.
The tally and its disclosure are application-level integration concepts, not shown as an unverified Compact API here.

codeBlocks.title: Vote commitment

title: Step 3: Uniqueness with nullifier
excerpts: A round-scoped nullifier prevents replayed double-voting.
Derive it from a private secret key, round context, and a domain-separating prefix.
The same secret and round are rejected; a new round is allowed.

codeBlocks.title: Nullifier for uniqueness

title: Step 4: DUST cost management
excerpts: Proof server generates the proof, consuming DUST.
Circuit must be optimized to minimize costs.

title: System architecture overview
excerpts: Ledger stores: Merkle root, vote commitment, nullifier set.

title: The complete circuit
excerpts: Verify Merkle membership against the authorized root.
Derive a persistent nullifier from a private secret key and round context.
Check and insert the nullifier in a ledger Set.
Commitment and tally integration remain conceptual in this teaching slice.

excerpts: Verify eligibility, encrypt vote, prevent double-voting, provide tally.
